# openwrt_dhcp_pool (Resource)

DHCP/RA settings for one interface (`config dhcp`).

Manages a `dhcp` section in `/etc/config/dhcp`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `interface` (String) Logical interface. (UCI option `interface`.)
- `section` (String) UCI section name. Changing it renames the section in place.

### Optional

- `dhcp_option` (List of String) Extra DHCP options, e.g. `6,192.168.1.1`. (UCI option `dhcp_option`.)
- `dhcp_option_force` (List of String) DHCP options sent even when not requested. (UCI option `dhcp_option_force`.)
- `dhcpv4` (String) DHCPv4 mode (odhcpd). (UCI option `dhcpv4`.) One of: `server`, `disabled`.
- `dhcpv6` (String) DHCPv6 mode. (UCI option `dhcpv6`.) One of: `server`, `relay`, `hybrid`, `disabled`.
- `dns` (List of String) DNS servers announced via DHCPv6/RA. (UCI option `dns`.)
- `dns_service` (Boolean) Announce the router as DNS server. (UCI option `dns_service`.)
- `domain` (List of String) Search domains announced via DHCPv6/RA. (UCI option `domain`.)
- `extra_lists` (Map of List of String) Additional list options not covered by this resource's attributes. Only listed keys are managed.
- `extra_options` (Map of String) Additional scalar options not covered by this resource's attributes. Only listed keys are managed.
- `force` (Boolean) Serve even if another DHCP server is detected. (UCI option `force`.)
- `ignore` (Boolean) Do not serve DHCPv4 on this interface. (UCI option `ignore`.)
- `instance` (String) dnsmasq instance. (UCI option `instance`.)
- `leasetime` (String) Lease time, e.g. `12h`. (UCI option `leasetime`.)
- `limit` (Number) Number of leasable addresses. (UCI option `limit`.)
- `master` (Boolean) Master interface for relaying. (UCI option `master`.)
- `max_preferred_lifetime` (String) Maximum preferred lifetime. (UCI option `max_preferred_lifetime`.)
- `ndp` (String) NDP proxy mode. (UCI option `ndp`.) One of: `relay`, `hybrid`, `disabled`.
- `netmask` (String) Netmask override. (UCI option `netmask`.)
- `networkid` (String) dnsmasq network id / tag. (UCI option `networkid`.)
- `preferred_lifetime` (String) Preferred lifetime for DHCPv6/RA. (UCI option `preferred_lifetime`.)
- `ra` (String) Router advertisement mode. (UCI option `ra`.) One of: `server`, `relay`, `hybrid`, `disabled`.
- `ra_default` (Number) Announce default route: 0 auto, 1 without public prefix, 2 always. (UCI option `ra_default`.)
- `ra_flags` (List of String) RA flags: `managed-config`, `other-config`, `home-agent`, `none`. (UCI option `ra_flags`.)
- `ra_slaac` (Boolean) Announce SLAAC prefixes. (UCI option `ra_slaac`.)
- `start` (Number) Offset of the first leased address. (UCI option `start`.)
- `tag` (List of String) Tags for this pool. (UCI option `tag`.)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<config>.<section>`.
